title: Sparkly pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffe066">
    <path d="M18 14 l2 6 6 2 -6 2 -2 6 -2 -6 -6 -2 6 -2 z"/>
    <path d="M84 20 l1.6 5 5 1.6 -5 1.6 -1.6 5 -1.6 -5 -5 -1.6 5 -1.6 z"/>
    <path d="M80 76 l1.6 5 5 1.6 -5 1.6 -1.6 5 -1.6 -5 -5 -1.6 5 -1.6 z"/>
    <path d="M14 70 l1.4 4.4 4.4 1.4 -4.4 1.4 -1.4 4.4 -1.4 -4.4 -4.4 -1.4 4.4 -1.4 z"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="2.6"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="50" r="2.6"/>
    <circle cx="8" cy="44" r="2.6"/>
  </g>
  <!-- blades -->
  <g fill="#bfe9ff" stroke="#7fd0f5" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M50 52 L78 22 c3 -3 8 1 5 5 L56 56 z"/>
    <path d="M50 52 L22 22 c-3 -3 -8 1 -5 5 L44 56 z"/>

  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
    <path d="M72 27 l3 -3 4 3 -4 2 z"/>
    <path d="M28 27 l-3 -3 -4 3 4 2 z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- handles -->
  <g fill="none" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round">
    <circle cx="38" cy="76" r="12" stroke="#ff7a5c"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="76" r="12" stroke="#ffb13d"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5" stroke="#ffffff">
    <circle cx="38" cy="76" r="12"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="76" r="12"/>
  </g>
  <!-- pivot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="5" fill="#c9a8ff" stroke="#e8d9ff" stroke-width="2"/>
</svg>
